questions.question:
Select the most appropriate segment to substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.
He always used to say that he was not a beggar by choice and if someone couldemploy him, he would like to eat
questions.solution:
A)‘like to eat'के बदले 'love to work' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि वह कहना चाहता है कि अगर उसे कोई नौकरी दे तो वह काम करने को पसंद करेगा। 'like to eat' का प्रयोग सही संदर्भ में नहीं है; जैसे— He always used to say that he was not a beggar by choice and if someone could employ him, he would love to work.
‘love to work' will be used instead of 'like to eat' because he wants to say that if someone could employ him, he would like to work. The phrase 'like to eat' is not appropriate in the given context; Like— He always used to say that he was not a beggar by choice and if someone could employ him, he would love to work.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
It is a fact that the same judgement can often be taken by more than one way.
questions.solution: B)'be taken by more than'के बदले 'be taken in more than' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'in' का प्रयोग किया जाता है जब एक ही वस्तु या विषय को विभिन्न दृष्टिकोणों से देखने या समझने की बात होती है; जैसे— It is a fact that the same judgement can often be taken in more than one way.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.
My son will carry out my business in my absence
questions.solution:
B)carry out my business'के बदले 'carry on my business' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'carry on' का अर्थ 'to continue' होता है; अत: ‘my son will carry on my business in my absence’ सही sentence है।
'carry on' will be used instead of 'carry out my business' because 'carry on' means 'to continue'; Hence, 'my son will carry on my business in my absence' is the correct sentence.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
The company plans to expand its business to the international market
questions.solution: C) to expand'के बदले 'to increase' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'expand' का अर्थ है 'फैलाना' जो 'increase' के करीब है; जैसे—The company plans to increase its business to the international market.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined part of the following sentence.
Mathew decided to complete the marathon to prove that he is still fit as a fiddle in hiseighties
options: an owner of a fit horse
questions.solution:
D)'fit as a fiddle'का अर्थ 'a fit and energetic person'है जो Mathewके संदर्भ में उसके स्वस्थ और ऊर्जावान होने कासंकेत देता है, अत:सही विकल्प'a fit and energetic person' होगा; जैसे— Mathew ने marathon को पूरा करने का निर्णय लिया यह साबित करने के लिए कि वह अपने अस्सी साल की उम्र में भी स्वस्थ और ऊर्जावान व्यक्ति है।
'a fit and energetic person' will be used instead of 'fit as a fiddle' because 'fit as a fiddle' means 'a fit and energetic person', which indicates Mathew's health and energy in his eighties; Like— Mathew decided to complete the marathon to prove that he is still a fit and energetic person in his eighties.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
The manager, decided at last to bring the stenographer to book for her illegal money transactions after trying to ignore it several times
options: bring her for a detailed investigation
place her in a safe supportive position
make her accountable for her conduct
questions.solution: D) 'bring the stenographer to book'के बदले 'make her accountable for her conduct' का use होगा क्योंकि इसका सही अर्थ है कि उसे उसके आचरण के लिए जिम्मेदार ठहराना; जैसे— The manager, decided at last to make her accountable for her conduct for her illegal money transactions after trying to ignore it several times.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option with correct usage of the preposition to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
The Centre of Excellence for Data Analytics (CEDA) provides quality data analyticservices to various government departments on all levels as well as to public sectorunits at the Centre and in states.
options: various government departments through all levels
various government departments from all levels
various government departments in all levels
various government departments at all levels
questions.solution:
D)various government departments at all levels
'On' के बदले 'at'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि ‘at all levels’ एक सामान्य preposition phrase है जो विभिन्न स्तरों (levels) पर चीजों या व्यक्तियों की उपस्थिति या पहुंच को व्यक्त करता है। उदाहरण— The training was conducted at all levels of the organization.
• 'At'will be used instead of 'on' because ‘at all levels’ is a common prepositional phrase used to express presence or involvement across various levels. Example— The training was conducted at all levels of the organization

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.
This is the group of leaders in whom the ruling government has placed its trust
questions.solution:
A)No substitution
'In whom' सही prepositional usage है क्योंकि यहां 'whom' का प्रयोग preposition 'in' के साथ object के रूप में किया गया है। 'Whom' का उपयोग तब किया जाता है जब वह object हो, न कि subject। उदाहरण— The person in whom I trust is my friend. अतः कोई substitution आवश्यक नहीं है।
• 'In whom' is the correct prepositional usage because 'whom' is used as the object of the preposition 'in'. 'Whom' is used when it acts as an object, not as a subject. Example— The person in whom I trust is my friend. Therefore, no substitution is necessary

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
During the preparation for competitive exams, Meena avoided going to parties
questions.solution: B)'avoided'के बदले 'steered clear of' का use होगा क्योंकि 'avoided' का अर्थ 'stay away from' होता है और यह phrase 'steer clear of' के synonymous है; जैसे— During the preparation for competitive exams, Meena steered clear of going to parties.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the meaning of the underlined segment.
Partly, it may be a desire to stop emotions in front of strangers
questions.solution: C)to stop'के बदले 'quell' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'quell' का अर्थ है 'to stop or put an end to,' और यह contextually सही है; जैसे— He tried to quell his anger in front of the strangers.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate segment to substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.
You have tears, prepare to shed them now
questions.solution:
A)'If you have tears' का use सही होगा क्योंकि यह conditional clause को व्यक्त करता है, जिसका अर्थ है कि अगर आपके पास आँसू हैं, तो उन्हें बहाने के लिए तैयार हो जाइए। यहाँ sentence में एक प्रकार की condition को व्यक्त किया जा रहा है, इसलिए "If you have tears" appropriate choice है।
'If you have tears' will be used because it expresses a conditional clause, meaning if you have tears, be ready to shed them. In the sentence, a condition is being expressed, so "If you have tears" is the appropriate choice.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.
In yesterday’s fire accident, her feets are burnt badly
questions.solution: C)her feet are'के बदले 'her feet were' का use होगा क्योंकि 'feet' का प्रयोग plural के रूप में होता है और 'yesterday’s fire accident' Past Tense में है; जैसे— In yesterday’s fire accident, her feet were burnt badly.

questions.question:
Select the word segment that can substitute the bracketed word segment correctly and complete the sentence meaningfully.
The minister promised to provide free laptops to the public if his (party came inpower).
questions.solution: C)Came in power'के बदले 'forms the government' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'if' Clause में verb 'promised' Past Tense में है अत: Conditional Clause में भी Verb Future Tense में होगा; जैसे— The minister promised to provide free laptops to the public if his party forms the government.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.
Inspite mother’s milk is vital to a child’s health, a number of FMCG companies wrongly advertise artificially prepared infant formulas as being the best for the child
questions.solution:
C) 'Inspite mother’s milk' के बदले'Though mother’s milk'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'Though' का अर्थ 'हालांकि' होता है, जो इस sentence में सही विरोधाभास (contrast) को दर्शाता है। 'Inspite' का प्रयोग गलत है क्योंकि इसके साथ 'of' का उपयोग होना चाहिए। जैसे— Though it was raining, we went for a walk.
'Though mother’s milk'will be used instead of 'Inspite mother’s milk' because 'Though' means 'although,' which correctly expresses the contrast intended in the sentence. The use of 'Inspite' is incorrect as it requires 'of' to be grammatically correct. Like— Though it was raining, we went for a walk.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence to make it a meaningful sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.
The quality of students of an educational institute is of great importance and a crucial starting point.
options: The quality of students in an educational institute is of great importance and a crucial starting point.
The quality of students in an educational institute is in great importance and a crucial starting point.
The quality of students in an educational institute is of great importance and is a crucial start point.
questions.solution:
A)The quality of students in an educational institute is of great importance and a crucial starting point.
‘of an educational institute' के बदले'in an educational institute'का use होगा क्योंकि 'quality of students' को जिस संस्थान में वह पढ़ते हैं, उस संदर्भ में व्यक्त किया जा रहा है। सही प्रीपोज़िशन 'in' का प्रयोग होगा। उदाहरण के लिए— The quality of students in an educational institute is of great importance and a crucial starting point.
'in an educational institute'will be used instead of 'of an educational institute' because 'quality of students' is being referred to in the context of the institution they attend. The correct preposition is 'in'. For example— The quality of students in an educational institute is of great importance and a crucial starting point.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.
He is feeding a male dog and female dog
options: a male dog and lady dog
questions.solution:
D) ‘a dog and a bitch'का use होगा क्योंकि यहाँ sentence में 'female dog' के लिए सही word 'bitch' है, और 'male dog' के लिए सही word 'dog' है। इसलिए, 'a dog and a bitch' सही है।
'a dog and a bitch'will be used because in the sentence, the correct word for 'female dog' is 'bitch,' and the correct word for 'male dog' is 'dog.' Therefore, the correct option is 'a dog and a bitch.'

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
She asked me where my hometown is and where I worked
questions.solution:
A)‘hometown is' के बदले'hometown was'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'asked' के बाद आने वाले Clause में Verb Past Tense में होगा। उदाहरण— She asked me where my hometown was and where I worked.
'hometown was'will be used instead of 'hometown is' because the verb in the clause following 'asked' should be in Past Tense. For example— She asked me where my hometown was and where I worked.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the highlighted words in the given sentence.
The serenity of the river was a sight to behold
questions.solution: B)a sight to behold' के बदले''pleasant to see'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'a sight to behold' का अर्थ होता है 'देखने में सुखद' और यह context में सही है; जैसे— The serenity of the river was pleasant to see.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.
Ice melts fastly, in the sun
questions.solution:
A)'melts fastly' के बदले 'melts fast' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'fastly' incorrect है; 'fast' एक adverb है जो verb 'melts' को modify करता है। उदाहरण के लिए— "She runs fast," न कि "She runs fastly"। अतः 'fast' का प्रयोग सही है।
'melts fast'will be used instead of 'melts fastly' because 'fastly' is incorrect; 'fast' is an adverb that modifies the verb 'melts'. For example— "She runs fast," not "She runs fastly." Therefore, 'fast' is the correct usage.

questions.question:
Three segments of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. One of them may contain an error. Select the option that contains the error. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.
Although there is no proven data, the Centre for Policy Research estimate that India has the largest stock of iron ore in the world.
options: Although there is no proven data,
questions.solution:
D)'estimate' के बदले'estimates'का use होगा क्योंकि 'Centre for Policy Research' एक singular entity है और उसके लिए singular verb का प्रयोग होगा।
'estimates'will be used instead of 'estimate' because 'Centre for Policy Research' is a singular entity, and a singular verb is required for it.
